cohort: 819 women who delivered at Clinical Emergency Hospital "Saint John", "Bucur" Maternity from January 1st, 2015 to December 31st, 2015
finding: Nuchal cord at birth is a frequent finding and is not associated with poor neonatal outcome in most cases.
mod_finding: The presence of nuchal cord at ultrasound scan in the third trimester or in the labor ward does not impose Caesarian section delivery.
